# Spec clauses whose documented-by value is none or not yet mapped.
# Generated by make write-undocumented. Document a clause rather than editing here: while the two
# disagree, make check-spec fails.
# Source: docs/specs/**/*.md, one line per clause, as path:CLAUSE-ID: heading.
# Withdrawn clauses carry no documented-by line at all and are not listed.
# No count is kept here. Two branches that each document a clause both edit the count, so it conflicts
# where the lists themselves merge cleanly, and a count nothing reads is wrong quietly. Count the
# lines, or read the warnings check-spec prints.
